# 2 Clement — Chapter 11 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 11
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Let us serve God with undivided hearts, and we will be righteous. But if we hold back from serving him because we don't really believe his promises, we are miserable people.
2. The prophetic scriptures say: "Miserable are the waverers — those who are torn in their own hearts, who say: 'Our fathers heard these same things, and we've been waiting day after day, but we have seen none of it come true.'"
3. You foolish people! Think about a vine: first it drops its leaves, then a bud appears, then an unripe grape, then a full ripe cluster.
4. In the same way, my people went through hardship and suffering — but then afterward they received what was good.
5. So, brothers, let us stop wavering. Let us hold on with hope, so that we too may receive our reward.
6. The one who made the promises is faithful — he will pay every person exactly what their deeds deserve.
7. If we live justly and rightly before him, we will enter his kingdom and receive the promises that no ear has heard, no eye has seen, and no human heart has imagined.
